title: IIIT Pune Selected as Onsite Centre for ICPC Kanpur Multi-Site 2026 Regional Contest
desc: The Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Pune has been selected as one of the three official onsite centres for the ICPC Kanpur Multi-Site 2026 Regional Contest. The prestigious International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC), often regarded as the Olympics of university-level programming, will bring the regional competition to Pune for the first time. The onsite contest is scheduled to be held on 22–23 December 2026 at IIIT Pune, alongside CSJM University Kanpur and IIT Gandhinagar. The event will provide students from Maharashtra and neighbouring regions with an opportunity to compete at a global standard in competitive programming, problem-solving, teamwork and algorithmic excellence.

title: IIIT Pune in News for Six Research Projects Worth ₹7.84 Crore
desc: The Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Pune is undertaking six major research projects with financial support of ₹7.84 crore. The projects focus on emerging and future technologies, including artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, semiconductors, quantum computing, and advanced communication technologies. The research initiatives are being carried out in collaboration with various national institutions and agencies, with the objective of developing innovative technological solutions and strengthening research capabilities at IIIT Pune.

title: IIIT Pune launches three new B.Tech programmes
desc: The Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Pune has launched three new B.Tech programmes in Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, and Semiconductor Engineering, expanding its academic offerings to meet emerging industry demands and prepare students for future technologies.

title: Yoga Day Celebrated with Various Activities at IIIT Pune
desc: International Yoga Day was celebrated with great enthusiasm and a unique spirit at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT), Pune, this year. Under the guidance of Institute Director Prof. Vineet Kansal and with the cooperation of Registrar Dr. Nagendra Kushwaha, a series of innovative programs spanning an entire week rather than just a single day, was organized.

title: IIIT Pune Hosts First Alumni Meet, Showcases Growth in Research, Placements and Infrastructure
desc: The Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune), an Institute of National Importance established by the Government of India under the Ministry of Education, successfully organised its First Alumni Meet – Pune Chapter at its campus in Nanoli Tarf Chakan, Talegaon, Maval, on Saturday.

title: नोकऱ्या देणारे विद्यार्थी घडवा
desc: 'तंत्रज्ञान क्षेत्रातील वेगवान बदलांच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर विद्यार्थ्यांनी केवळ नोकरीच्या संधी शोधण्याऐवजी उद्योजकतेची मानसिकता विकसित करून रोजगारनिर्मितीकडे वाटचाल करावी. उद्योजकता, नाविन्यपूर्ण विचारसरणी आणि जबाबदार कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्तेच्या माध्यमातून समाजासाठी नव्या संधी निर्माण करणे ही काळाची गरज आहे,' असे मत 'आयआयटी, कानपूर'चे माजी संचालक प्रा. संजय धांडे यांनी व्यक्त केले.

title: IIIT Pune and NIT Raipur professors to be part of Rs4cr centrally-funded project to build next-gen digital forensic tools
desc: Pune: Professors from the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Pune, along with the National Institute of Technology (NIT) Raipur, will be part of a Rs4.2 crore project commissioned by the cyber security division of the Union Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) to develop next-generation digital forensics tools over the next two years.
